slide1.headline: Cerebras Plans to List Next Week
slide1.subtitle: Targeting Largest US IPO of the Year

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 09 May 2026
Cerebras plans to list next week, targeting the largest US IPO of the year.
The company aims to raise $3.5 billion.
This move is expected to add a heavyweight player to the AI chip sector.

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
lines: Cerebras' listing is a significant development in the AI chip sector.
The company's IPO is expected to have a substantial impact on the market.
Source: TradingKey, 09 May 2026

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: Event date: 04 May 2026
Cisco has acquired Astrix, an AI security startup, for $400 million.
The acquisition is expected to enhance Cisco's security capabilities.
Astrix's AI-powered security solutions will be integrated into Cisco's portfolio.

The integration of Astrix's AI-powered security solutions will provide Cisco's customers with advanced security features.
Source: CTech, 04 May 2026

OpenAI has rolled out GPT-5.5 Instant, an improved version of its language model.
GPT-5.5 Instant has enhanced accuracy and new features, including improved conversational capabilities.
The new model has been set as the default for ChatGPT.

lines: The improved accuracy and new features of GPT-5.5 Instant are expected to enhance the user experience of ChatGPT.
The update is a significant development in the field of AI research, demonstrating the rapid progress being made in language models.
The new model has the potential to be used in a wide range of applications, from customer service to content creation.
